identity.title: High gas-to-dust size ratio indicating efficient radial drift in the mm-faint CX Tauri disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this letter, we present significantly higher angular resolution ALMA data of CX Tau at 1.3 mm that provide new insights into the properties of its gas and dust components.

evidence.quote: CX Tau is an M2.5 star, located at $127.9\pm0.7\,$pc from the Sun

question.value: How compact is the mm dust disk of CX Tau relative to its CO gas disk, and does it show substructure, indicating radial drift?

evidence.quote: CX Tau is a good target that can be used to characterize the gas and dust properties (in particular the radial extent) of a compact continuum protoplanetary disk

findings_qualitative.value: Continuum shows no significant substructure at ~55x32 mas resolution

evidence.quote: The continuum intensity profile does not show any significant level of substructure at the angular resolution of the observations

claims.hypothesis: Is the gas disk much more extended than the mm dust in a compact disk?
claims.experiment: Compared 68% and 90% enclosed-flux radii of 12CO and continuum
claims.result: R_gas/R_dust ≈ 5.4 (68%) and ≈ 3.9 (90%) versus 1.96 typical in Lupus
claims.finding: Large gas-to-dust size ratio argues for efficient radial drift

evidence.quote: The large difference in extent between mm continuum and molecular emission strongly argues for radial drift.

claims.hypothesis: Does the compact disk host rings, gaps or an inner cavity?
claims.experiment: uv-plane fit with smooth profile, residual imaging, added truncation radius
claims.finding: No substructure or cavity detected at this resolution

evidence.quote: The data do not show signatures of a cavity

claims.hypothesis: Are faint disks scaled-down versions of large disks?
claims.experiment: Compared intensity profile with DSHARP disks
claims.result: Profile resembles inner regions of DSHARP disks without outer rings
claims.finding: Faint disks are not scaled-down versions

evidence.quote: indicating that faint objects are not scaled-down versions of large disks in their continuum emission

why_this_method.value: Functional form chosen from the azimuthally averaged image profile

evidence.quote: By analysing the azimuthally averaged profile obtained from the image, we decided to use the functional form

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Adding rings and gaps to the model gave no better constraint

evidence.quote: Some attempts have been made to refine the model by adding rings and gaps, but no better constraint was obtained.

limitations_admitted.value: Gas surface density cannot be retrieved, so dust-size vs dust-to-gas depletion cannot be disentangled

evidence.quote: Disentangling between the two effects requires knowing the gas surface density, which cannot be retrieved with the present data.
